item.title: kladde-cpp
item.description: The C++ implementation of kladde: one of the two reference implementations of the specification, independent of kladde-rs in Rust, and the library behind the Inkscape demo.

item.title: Evaluation
item.description: Measurements of kladde-rs and, in the Inkscape demo, kladde-cpp under realistic workloads, and what they say about the design.

item.title: Consolidation
item.description: Reclaiming garbage: which pages to rewrite, in what order, and how much per flush.

item.title: Implementation
item.description: The reference algorithms and data structures: what an implementation must maintain in memory to satisfy the specification, and how it maintains it.

item.title: Transactions and batches
item.description: How application operations are grouped into the transactions the journal records, how they wait in memory, and when they are appended to the journal pages and folded.

item.title: kladde
item.description: Durable data structures: mutate in memory, and it’s on disk.

item.title: kladde-rs
item.description: The Rust implementation of kladde: one of the two reference implementations of the specification, with kladde-cpp in C++.

item.title: Durability
item.description: Which pages a write may touch, the protocol that commits a flush, and exactly what survives a crash.

item.title: File format
item.description: The page layer: how a kladde file is divided, what every page carries, how a file is identified, and how versions are negotiated. Status: draft.
